name: clone a git repository to a target directory
definition: Clone a specific external repo at a requested location under the workspace.
failure_mode: Clone to wrong path or incomplete checkout breaks downstream install.

name: deploy pushed branches to a served directory via a git (post-)receive hook
definition: A receive-side hook that checks out pushed branches into the served dir so content updates promptly.
failure_mode: Without the hook, pushed files never reach the web root, so the served content is wrong or missing.

name: expunge a secret from all reachable and dangling git entities
definition: remove a secret from the working tree and rewrite history so no reachable commit or blob contains it, while cleaning dangling objects so a content scan finds nothing.
failure_mode: leaving the secret in a rewritten commit, its message, or a dangling blob fails.

name: identify various credential formats in repository files
definition: Scan config and source files for recognizable forms of cloud/git/inference tokens (representations for a group of well-known secret patterns) and count of them, case-insensitively.
